title: The Leakage Advisor asks no model inside notes_off
request: The planning exam v3's table run started; the Leakage Advisor (another agent's change, 815c0ded) called a live model from stage_leakage.
spec: Inside notes_off no stage asks a model; the advisor's rules and heuristics still run.

decisions.decision: Stop the exam's table run after one build
decisions.why: every build would send held-out column information to a model outside the exam's cap and sealed vault, in the rules arm too

findings.defect: The Leakage Advisor ignored notes_off and called the process's model inside stage_leakage.
findings.scenario: hp_gate_v3's table run, rules arm, first build: one leakage_review exchange in the development workspace's log, outside the exam's cap and vault.
findings.cause: engine.py read models.installed() directly; only stage notes honoured notes_off
findings.fix: notes_allowed() checked before asking for the advisor's client

outcome: Team runs and exams keep every model request in their own capped gateway again.
lessons: A new model call in a stage must honour the stage's no-model switch: check every path that runs stages under a cap.
risks: One held-out exchange sits in the development log until it is moved.
